query.sql: SELECT customers.region_id, SUM(orders.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders INNER JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id INNER JOIN regions ON customers.region_id = regions.id WHERE orders.amount >= 10.0 AND orders.status = 1 AND customers.active = 1 GROUP BY customers.region_id ORDER BY customers.region_id
